prompt: Build the Thousand Sunny, the pirate ship from One Piece — a large sailing galleon with its unmistakable signature feature: a huge grinning golden LION FIGUREHEAD at the bow (front), with a big round face, a flowing sunburst mane radiating outward, and a wide smile. The ship has a curved wooden hull, a grassy lawn deck on top, two tall masts with square white sails, and the lion head jutting proudly off the front. Use PLANKS and OAK_LOG for the wooden hull and masts, SAND/PLANKS for the golden lion head and its sunburst mane (yellow-tan), GRASS for the lawn deck, SNOW for the white sails, BRICK for red trim accents along the hull. The lion figurehead is the iconic element and must be large and clearly a smiling lion face with a radiating mane. Orient the ship so the lion figurehead faces the viewer. Make it big and unmistakably the Thousand Sunny.
